items.extra: Extra for this session (about seventy-five minutes, processors only). Gate G2 of this track was NOT passed (coord/GATES.md; coord/DECISIONS/0047; stage/G2/GATE_REVIEW.md): record it in STATUS and HANDOFF without softening it. (1) The cheap decisive test of condition (b) FIRST: the horizon finder of core-v0.8 with polishing (<fastflow> polish_iterations_<n> = 100 with mass_tol_<n> = 1e-5, diagnostics = true; coord/INTERFACES/finder_stop.md) searching again on the existing restart files of the periodic chain P0L6 between t = 122 and 140 and of the triaxial run S1L near its end, on processors with .work/build_cpu_v08 (how core searched Track D's restart dumps again: tracks/core/analysis/restart_finder/ on main); if the restart files of the older build are refused by the new one, say so and use the build that wrote them with the options it has. Prediction first: does it find the trapped surface where tracked shells are trapped, with no false acceptance? Every search starts from a sphere of the last mean radius: if the options allow an initial radius, also start at the radius of the trapped shells. If the finder still fails, write for core the smallest reproducer (restart file, deck, the radius expected from the tracked shells) and post it (outbox to core): core's source session after 2026-11-27 takes it. (2) The cheap processor tests of the constraint floor that the gate review lists in its part on C3, in its order, as far as the time allows, predictions first. (3) Records and corrections: add to the checklist, as open items and in the words of scope section 7, the track's own G2 criteria written at G0; state in the note and the README, where the bracket is claimed, that under the outcome rule of scope section 3 every ball run is undecided (the ratio is 1.11 and 1.44 at detection in the bracket members); the tick labels of note Fig. 7(a); 'to turnaround' for the periodic shells; which Szekeres signal Table V uses, with the invariant one beside it; orders as ranges; the stale text of section VI and the summary; the dust-clock bound read from the particles' proper time in the snapshots (the second verifier's correction of A2X (ii)); regenerate STAGE_REPORT and EVIDENCE; C18 with both verifier reports and the six findings of VERIFIER.md section 4 answered.
